outcome.answer: The closest matches are [5], [1], and [8]. [5] trains reasoning on unverifiable data by having the model generate its own reasoning traces from standard question-answer pairs, creating a self-reinforcing feedback loop without expert-written demonstrations. [1] focuses on self-improvement without external feedback at test time, using self-generated verification signals to improve answer selection. [8] targets non-verifiable learning by using multi-agent self-play and meta-evaluation to create supervision for both generation and judging without ground-truth labels.
